zh-CN.title: 花间来日 · 生日祝福
items: 聊天等页面可设置生日，个人信息中也可管理；只保存月日，每 365 天可设置一次
生日当天享有个人专属的花间来日主题与全屏庆祝，不可转赠或分享
平台和空间管理员可分别致信，生日当天由本人拆阅

en.title: A garden of tomorrows · Birthday wishes
items: Set your birthday from chat reminders or personal information; only month and day are stored, changeable every 365 days
Enjoy your personal garden birthday theme and full-screen celebration on the day, without sharing or transfers
Platform and space administrators can each leave a private letter to unseal on your birthday
